title: Verilay Job History Credential v2
description: Credential asserting the subject's employment: which employer, over which dates, and optionally in what role — plus how it was verified: the grade on the employment scale, the source, the date, the evidence method and the hash of the evidence document. The employer is either a company registered in Verilay that attested it (companyId present) or an employer named on a state employment record (companyId absent). Only the former can gate review submission, because companyId is the join key between the credential and the reviews registry. Merklized: no iden3_serialization directive, every subject field is addressable through the merklization root.

companyId.title: Company ID
companyId.description: The attesting company's Verilay account user_uuid, in canonical lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hyphenated form. This is the identifier verilay-user-service exposes on the public business record and the one the reviews registry keys on — not a company name, domain or display label. String, so it supports equality and set-membership queries ($eq, $in, $nin) only. Optional in v2: present when a company registered in Verilay attested the employment, absent on a credential from a state employment record, which names an employer but not a Verilay account. Only a credential carrying companyId can gate a review.

role.title: Role
role.description: Job title as attested, as free text, e.g. "Senior Backend Engineer". Display and review-template use; string, so equality and set-membership queries only. Optional in v2: state employment records do not assert a role.

employedFrom.title: Employed From
employedFrom.description: First day of the employment period, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20210301. Integer encoding is what makes tenure and date-window checks expressible as on-chain range queries.

employedTo.title: Employed To
employedTo.description: Last day of the employment period, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD. Optional: absent means the employment had not ended according to the source at verification time. A policy that needs "employment has ended" must handle absence explicitly — claimPathNotExists is part of the queryHash for exactly this case.

employerName.title: Employer Name
employerName.description: The employer's name as the source states it: the attesting company's name in Verilay, or the employer named on the state employment record, e.g. "Acme Iberia S.L.". A display string, not a join key — companyId is the join key where present. Equality and set-membership queries only.

employerTaxId.title: Employer Tax ID
employerTaxId.description: The employer's tax identifier as the source record states it, e.g. a Spanish NIF/CIF or a Portuguese NIPC. Optional: sources that do not state one omit it. Equality and set-membership queries only.

contributionDays.title: Contribution Days
contributionDays.description: Number of social-insurance contribution days the source record attributes to this employment. Optional: only sources that state it provide it. Integer, so range queries.

sourceCaveat.title: Source Caveat
sourceCaveat.description: A limitation the source itself places on what its verification proves, e.g. that a verification code confirms the authenticity of the document but not the validity of the data in it. Optional; display only.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: How strongly the source proved this employment, as an ordinal integer on the employment scale: CRYPTO=6, SOCIAL_INSURANCE=5, PAYROLL=4, EMPLOYER_ATTESTED=3, GIG_PLATFORM=2, APOSTILLE_ONLY=1, UNVERIFIABLE=0. Higher is stronger, so "at least" a grade is an on-chain range query (grade >= N), the same way degreeLevel works. UNVERIFIABLE (0) is part of the scale but no credential is ever issued at 0: a request that cannot be verified ends without a credential. The scale is frozen with this schema version; adding, removing or reordering a grade is a new schema version.

source.title: Source
source.description: Identifier of the verification source that produced the grade, e.g. "es.vida_laboral" — the issuer's source-adapter id, or a finer source name where one adapter covers several. Equality and set-membership queries only.

verifiedAt.title: Verified At
verifiedAt.description: Date the verification concluded, encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20260923. Integer encoding makes "verified since" a range query.

documentHash.title: Document Hash
documentHash.description: SHA-256 of the evidence document's bytes exactly as submitted to the issuer, as 64 lowercase hex characters. Binds the credential to the document that was verified without disclosing it. Optional: absent when the source had no document to hash — never the empty string, which cannot be merklized. Equality queries only.

evidenceMethod.title: Evidence Method
evidenceMethod.description: How the evidence was checked, e.g. XADES_ICP_BRASIL_OFFLINE, PORTAL_CODE_RECHECK, OPERATOR_PORTAL_CHECK, EMPLOYER_ATTESTATION_SIGNED. Distinguishes an automated check from an operator-resolved one at the same grade. Equality and set-membership queries only.
